nodes.hint_edit: A radiology report counts as imaging. A pathology report on a biopsy, curettage or resection counts as histology.

options.label_head: Referral letter or clinical note only — no imaging report, no cytology
options.rationale: Lowest tier. It fits any set with no Imaging Report, Cytology or Histology Report, including nothing ticked and a lone Lab Report, IHC Report or Gene report. Lab, IHC and genetics are not excluded, so those sets do not dead-end and the tier understates rather than overstates.

options.label_head: X-ray, CT or MRI report — no tissue (cytology or histology) in the fil
options.rationale: Requires the Imaging Report and excludes Cytology and Histology Report to honour 'no tissue'. Lab, IHC and genetics ticked beside imaging without a tissue document stay at this tier, which understates. The gate has no laboratory tier, so Lab Report does not change the fit.

options.label_head: Histology report from a biopsy, curettage or resection
options.rationale: Fits every set that holds the Histology Report. It is the highest tier and the only fit for those sets. IHC and genetics refine it only beside the Histology Report and need no separate option.

options.label_head: Fine-needle aspiration or other cytology report only — no histology re
options.rationale: Requires the Cytology document itself and excludes Histology Report to honour 'no histology report'. Imaging may also be ticked. IHC beside cytology is immunocytochemistry and stays at this tier; genetics beside cytology likewise.

options.label_head: A specimen was taken but the report calls it inadequate, non-diagnosti
options.rationale: An inadequate, non-diagnostic or uninterpretable specimen does not follow from which documents exist. It is a context option with no tick rules.

options.label_head: The tumour arises in soft tissue, not bone — the mass is outside the b
options.rationale: The site is not established as bone and the option redirects to Group IX. That is a situation, not a document combination, so it is a context option with no tick rules and the clerk can always choose it.

nodes.hint_was: Pick the highest tier of evidence genuinely in the file. A radiology report counts as imaging. A pathology report on a biopsy, curettage or resection counts as histology.
